description: Plan 261006 Phase 8 gate (user decision 2026-10-06, "stale_when_fired only"): stale_when_fired is a trigger flag. A quiet project whose only flag is stale_when_fired is `flagged` (stored 2, below QUIET_PERIODIC_AT), and so is a user memory whose only flag is stale_when_fired (file_flags name it). A project whose only flag is stale_when_unknown (no kiro-cli log carries a version) stays null.
